reading.title: Safer Streets
reading.text: Last year the crime rate in the town of Eastbrook was one of the highest in the region. Most offences were petty crime, such as taking bicycles, but a few were more serious. The council decided to take action. It put new lights in dark streets and asked residents to report any crime they saw. Police also visited schools to talk about crime prevention. A year later, the crime rate fell by twenty per cent. The mayor said that people had worked together to fight crime, and she thanked everyone who helped.

reading.title: Learning from a Mistake
reading.text: Jake is sixteen. Last spring he drew pictures on the wall of a railway station with friends. It was his first offence, but it was still a criminal offence because the wall belonged to the railway company. He was not a repeat offender, and he never did it again. Today he talks to other young people about what he learned.

reading.text: When Sam's bicycle disappeared from the school yard, the headteacher asked a police officer to help. The officer began to gather evidence. reading.title: A Fair Decision
reading.text: Last month a man in our town cut down trees in a public park without asking for permission. He went to court. The judge said that the offence was serious because the park belongs to everyone. She did not send him to prison. Instead, she gave him a suspended sentence and a heavy fine. He also had to plant new trees. The judge explained that a sentence should be fair and should help people to learn from their mistakes. Many people in the town agreed with this decision. The man paid the fine and planted twenty trees.

reading.title: What Is the Purpose of Prison?
reading.text: People sometimes ask why we have prisons. A prison is a place where people who commit serious crimes can be sent. It keeps society safe, and it is also a punishment. However, many experts say that punishment alone is not enough. Inside a prison, people can study, learn a job and meet a counsellor. Prison officers also help them prepare for life after release. When a person is released from prison, a job can help them stay away from crime. That is why many people support prison reform and fair punishment that helps people change.
